limits: First three exploratory runs have unequal input counts/capture durations and are not matched comparisons.
Final pair uses the same ten inputs, window, density, first-photo selection, settled indexing and warmed rows; it is one pair with uncontrolled OS caches and scripted accessibility overhead.
Input endpoint positions were observed before capture ended; individual inputs were not timestamp-correlated to trace rows.
Potential stalls and sampled CPU weight do not measure presented FPS, dropped frames, subjective smoothness or competitor parity.
Content-origin geometry optimization was withdrawn after failed native selection acceptance.
